title: Nice and warm
text: Nice and warm. This is a nice throw blanket for kids who love to game...yes adults too. Lol. Its just a bit thicker than I thought it would be. Covers you nicely or wear over your shoulders. My grdaughter loves it. Can be hung on a wall as well.

product_metadata.title: Calhoun Novelty Keeping It Classic Retro Gaming Ultra Plush Decorative Throw Blanket
features: CALLING ALL GAMERS: Grab this gaming blanket, forget your to-do list, and spend a few hours to yourself bundled up with your favorite video game. This blanket is great item to add to your gaming station.

FABRIC AND SIZE: The blanket is made from 100% polyester microfleece and measures 50 inches by 60 inches. We use low pile fleece in order to keep the printed graphics very clear. Since we use lightweight fabric the blanket is not a heavy blanket. It is a fun, playful conversation piece. Machine wash cold is recommended.

SUBLIMATION PRINTING: Sublimation printing is a method of using dye to transfer into the fabric. It creates detailed, vibrant, and durable designs with a soft-hand finish. The print on our blankets will never fade, wash out, and become dull.

ALL YEAR USE: This blanket was designed with the intention of all year use. It is light enough to use in the spring for picnics, outings, and at home lounging but can also be used in the winter for an extra bed or couch cover.
QUALITY GUARANTEE: We stand behind our products and encourage feedback. All products are guaranteed for 100% customer satisfaction. Returns will always be accepted when necessary.
